prompt: List the web orders (channel web) placed on 7 March 2025 with the product of each of their order lines. order_ts holds UTC time: take the day in UTC. Keep an order that has no lines: product_id is missing for it. Return two columns, in this order: order_id and product_id. Return one row for each order line, plus one row for each order with no lines. Any row order is fine.

output_contract.grain: one row per order line, plus one per order with no lines

hints: Next, join the order lines so that an order with no lines still shows.
The channel and date tests are on orders, the table you keep whole, so they can stay in WHERE.
faded_shape:
SELECT o.order_id, l.product_id
FROM orders o
faded_suffix:
WHERE o.channel = 'web'
  AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-07 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-08 00:00:00'
why_this_works: LEFT JOIN keeps each web order of the day; an order with no lines gets one row with a missing product_id.
